scope: Owned-PC ordinary and loop single-hit, one-unit ammunition transactions for fresh and complete transferred characters. Inventory, core, timers and audit commit before original responses.

source_authority.contract: UseSkillItem checks cash overrides, then optional reagent, then the first compatible powered equipped weapon. Its use-item kind selects stacks ordered within one bag; consume weapon count plus additional hit count, then MOVEITEM.
Flagged targets build bTotalHit; multi-attack may expand it. Both request paths pass BYTE(bTotalHit-1) to UseSkillItem. This increment requires exactly one non-expanded hit.
IsMultiAttack scans all data for SDT_ABILITY and MTYPE_EFC; those templates remain unsupported for ammo.
Cash bolt 25020, arrow 25021 and axe 25022 are referenced by source but absent from the immutable backup item catalog.
UseItem decrements/deletes exact stack and emits original inventory response.
Private UPDATEITEM or DELITEM then MOVEITEM precede ordinary/loop result.

pinned_content.source_changes: None. Only disposable synthetic-owned items/skills and restored synthetic routing partitions are changed.

implementation.selection: Pinned per-character item kind and first compatible equipped weapon determine ammunition kind. Require powered weapon count one, no separate skill reagent, no source multi-attack effect, and one flagged target. Select earliest unsigned bag/slot of that kind; equipment consumption remains unsupported.
implementation.fresh_storage: The transaction locks the selecting owned inventory, verifies the loaded first compatible weapon full-row fingerprint and powered state, compares actual item kind and first selection, then validates the exact count/identity/template/storage/full-row hash before decrement or deletion.
implementation.graph_storage: Derive weapon and ordered kind selection from the locked canonical complete checkpoint and pinned charts. Existing full-graph validation permits exactly one item decrement/deletion plus current core and sampled timers. No stale normalized children are read or written.
implementation.publication: Same private plan, character freeze and checkpoint-operation lease as reagent casts. Publish only after confirmed commit; private UPDATEITEM/DELITEM then MOVEITEM, cast response and HPMP if charged. Missing ordinary ammo retains armed own/shared timers; missing loop ammo arms none.
implementation.uncertain_commit: No automatic retry; client closes, reservation remains, stale final save is refused. Existing modeled-unknown-outcome admission tests remain; native tests cover real rollback and process recovery after a confirmed commit.
implementation.deployment: Migration 024 adds consumption_kind reagent/ammunition, preserves existing receipts as reagent, and is required before these binaries for either consumption type. Existing Map grants suffice. Backups and migrations 001-023 retain hashes; 024 now immutable; next 025.

release.scope: Installed Release Login/World/Map daemons; backend/pool integration executables mounted from the verified Debug build.

regression_before.expected_failure: Map replica wire: graph cast emits no item or success response before delayed transaction completes
regression_before.scope: Previous installed graph-reagents daemons; current mounted backend/pool executables and migrations. The old server does not support native ammunition charging.

limitations: Only one non-expanded flagged target and one weapon-required unit; zero/multiple target charging, expanded hits, per-bag multi-stack BYTE arithmetic and reagent-plus-weapon combinations remain unsupported.
Cash template definitions are absent from the backup and not fabricated; premium overrides are not implemented.

Equipment/durability mutation, active effects, full damage/target/AOI rules and original-client executable acceptance remain pending. Source-derived encrypted peers supply synthetic target identities; they do not prove combat damage.
